Callout.Name: Stolen Quad Bike
Callout.Message: Quad bike taken from a farm yard.
Callout.Advisory: Taken overnight, tracks heading for the trails.

Script.Line: It was in the yard last night and this morning the gate was open.
Red, with a winch on the front. It is a working machine.
There are tyre marks running out to the road.

Lines.Approach: They wheeled it out in the night and it is on the trails somewhere.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
